findings.summary: The failure test's expected message embeds the full Attribute repr (type='int', alias=None), so it will break if Attribute gains or renames a field.

attrs is now iterated twice (by the check and by the alias list comprehension), so a field transformer returning a one-shot iterator such as a generator would leave the alias step with an empty sequence.
Many existing assertions were flipped to put the expected value first, which adds unrelated noise to the diff and has nothing to do with #1147; consider dropping those edits.
